articles.title: Tom Brady's Chelsea investment raises a bigger question about his ambitions after a turbulent Birmingham City ownership stint
articles.summary: Tom Brady has bought shares in Chelsea, sources told ESPN and NFL Network on Friday.
articles.body: Tom Brady has bought shares in Chelsea, sources told ESPN and NFL Network on Friday. The seven-time Super Bowl champion made the move less than two weeks after Birmingham City announced on Nov. 9 that he was leaving its ownership group. His stake size and the price have not been made public, and Chelsea and Clearlake Capital did not reply to ESPN's request for comment. Defense attorney Alex Spiro, part of Brady's ownership group, helped negotiate the deal. The Guardian reported the talks first. Brady held 3.3% of Birmingham and chaired its advisory board.Tom Brady buys into Chelsea after leaving Birmingham CityThe timing is hard to ignore. Clearlake Capital took full control of Chelsea in September, when Todd Boehly and Mark Walter sold their shares. The Financial Times reported that the pair will receive £950 million for their combined stake, in a deal that values the club at £5 billion including debt. Clearlake owned 61.5% before that. Swiss philanthropist Hansjörg Wyss stays on as a partner.He is not a stranger to the group. Clearlake co-founder Behdad Eghbali is reported to get along well with him, and Brady was at the 2025 Club World Cup final in New Jersey, where Chelsea beat Paris Saint-Germain 3-0.How things soured at BirminghamTom Brady joined Birmingham in August 2023 through Knighthead Capital Management, which is run by his friend and business partner Tom Wagner. The start was rough. Wayne Rooney was hired as head coach and fired after 83 days. Brady later questioned Rooney's work ethic in the Amazon series Built in Birmingham: Brady & the Blues, and Rooney hit back by saying Brady "didn't really understand football that well at that time."Birmingham fell to League One on his watch, then won promotion back and was top of the Championship when he left. The club thanked him for his "unwavering support." A source who spoke to Page Six described it differently.That source claimed Brady went to games and did press early on, but that eventually "he completely checked out." The same person added: "He'd fly to NYC and walk in a Gucci runway show for $180,000, but wouldn't go to BCFC games. They gave him equity and expected support," the source said. That is a single anonymous account, and none of the coverage confirms it independently.That contrast is what makes the Chelsea stake interesting. A 3.3% share in a Championship club is one thing. A Premier League side valued at £5 billion brings bigger crowds, tougher scrutiny and less patience. That is a different job from sitting on an advisory board. Brady also owns 5% of the Las Vegas Raiders, a stake NFL owners approved unanimously in 2024, so he knows what a minority owner is expected to do. For now, nobody outside the deal can say how big his Chelsea stake is.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Chiefs could abandon Tyreek Hill reunion plans as slow recovery forces Kansas City to explore another veteran WR
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs may have to rethink their plan for a Tyreek Hill reunion.
articles.body: The Kansas City Chiefs may have to rethink their plan for a Tyreek Hill reunion. Hill is still recovering from a serious knee injury suffered last season, and his agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said this week that the receiver has not been cleared to play. Rosenhaus has another client who could reach the open market soon, though. San Francisco 49ers receiver Brandon Aiyuk is healthy, and the 49ers appear ready to move on. For a Chiefs team that wants more help for Patrick Mahomes before the season ends, Aiyuk is now a name worth tracking.Chiefs may look beyond Tyreek Hill as his recovery drags onHill has long been seen as a natural fit in Kansas City. He and Mahomes clicked during his years with the Chiefs, and plenty of insiders expected the team to make a run at him this season. The Chiefs did add a receiver, trading for Josh Downs before the deadline. That was not the Hill move, though.Rosenhaus made it clear on The Russini Report that nobody can say when Hill will be back. He told host Dianna Russini he has no target date."I really don't have a timetable for him, because I respect the process. It's not about putting any pressure on him directly or indirectly in terms of when he returns to play," Rosenhaus said.For Kansas City, that leaves a waiting game with no end in sight. A team chasing wins in the final weeks cannot build a plan around a player who has no return date.Aiyuk could be a late-season option for Kansas CityRosenhaus said Aiyuk is medically cleared and ready to play. The snag is San Francisco, which has made it known he is not welcome back after the relationship broke down.He expects the 49ers to waive Aiyuk at some point, which would send him to free agency."I'm not sure what's going to happen with waivers because of his current contract, but our instinct is that he'll become a free agent and we'll have options," Rosenhaus said. "I'm not permitted to talk to teams, but based on my 38 years of experience and reading the tea leaves, I expect that he'll have many suitors…but he would like to get out there and play as soon as possible."The Chiefs have been floated as one possible landing spot. Daniel Mader of The Sporting News argued Aiyuk could help the receiver room, though he kept expectations in check."Expecting Aiyuk to immediately be the version of himself that finished with over 1,200 yards in 2023 is unrealistic, especially considering he hasn't even been in an NFL facility in months," Mader wrote. "But if Aiyuk can ramp back up a bit for a few weeks, by the tail end of the season, he could be a field-stretching weapon for Mahomes, averaging 14.6 yards per catch in his career."Hill's timeline is unknown. Aiyuk's hinges on San Francisco.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Colts Release Daniel Jones, Name Anthony Richardson Starting Quarterback
articles.summary: The Indianapolis Colts have finally reached their breaking point with Daniel Jones. Following another disastrous performance against the Houston Texans, Indi...
articles.body:
The Indianapolis Colts have finally reached their breaking point with Daniel Jones. Following another disastrous performance against the Houston Texans, Indianapolis has reportedly released Jones, ending a disappointing tenure that began with considerable expectations. The decision also means Anthony Richardson will take over as the team's starting quarterback.

The Colts announced Jones' release Friday, one day after their 26-3 loss to Houston. For Indianapolis, this represents more than another quarterback change. It signals the end of an experiment that never delivered the results the organization anticipated.

Jones entered the 2026 season with an opportunity to establish himself as Indianapolis' long-term answer under center. The Colts invested heavily in the veteran, bringing him back on a two-year, $88 million contract after his promising 2025 campaign ended prematurely because of an Achilles injury.

Unfortunately, the results this season have been difficult to defend. Jones struggled with turnovers, accuracy, and consistency throughout the campaign. His performance against Houston was another example of an offense that had seemingly lost its direction.

Jones completed just 12 of 27 passes for 144 yards and an interception. He also took a safety after being brought down in the end zone by Texans defensive end Will Anderson Jr.

Indianapolis managed just three points, 167 total yards and eight first downs against its division rival. The defeat dropped the Colts to 3-8, extending their losing stretch to six defeats in seven games. Jones also finished with 13 interceptions, leading the NFL at the time of Thursday's matchup.

Anthony Richardson Finally Gets Another Opportunity

Richardson's return to the starting lineup presents an opportunity that seemed increasingly unlikely throughout the season. The former fourth-overall selection entered the year behind Jones on the depth chart after losing the offseason quarterback competition. He had also requested a trade in February, creating additional uncertainty surrounding his future in Indianapolis.

With that being said, the Colts ultimately kept Richardson as their backup, giving him another opportunity to remain involved with the organization. His playing time has been almost nonexistent.

Richardson previously appeared in garbage time against Jacksonville, completing both of his passing attempts for eight yards in a 42-7 defeat. He also received a brief opportunity against Houston, completing neither of his two passes while adding two rushing yards. Those appearances hardly provide a meaningful evaluation of his development.

Richardson remains an intriguing talent because of his combination of arm strength, athleticism, and rushing ability. His physical tools have never been the primary concern. Instead, accuracy, decision-making, and availability have repeatedly prevented him from establishing himself as a dependable NFL starter.

Those concerns haven't disappeared simply because Jones is gone. Yet, the circumstances surrounding the Colts make this an ideal time to evaluate Richardson.

The organization is no longer operating with realistic postseason expectations. There is little reason to continue prioritizing a veteran quarterback who hasn't delivered consistent results over a young player whose future remains uncertain.

Indianapolis has spent several seasons searching for stability at quarterback following Andrew Luck's unexpected retirement. Richardson was supposed to be the answer when the organization selected him fourth overall in 2023. Instead, injuries and inconsistent performances have kept the former Florida quarterback from fulfilling that expectation.

Jones was supposed to provide a more dependable alternative. Now, both experiments have reached a crossroads.

The Colts have already undergone significant organizational changes this season, including the dismissal of general manager Chris Ballard and the departure of several prominent players through trades. The decision to move on from Jones would represent another significant step in reshaping the franchise.

Nonetheless, the most important question isn't whether Richardson can immediately turn Indianapolis around. It's whether the Colts can finally determine what they have in him.

If Richardson shows meaningful improvement, the organization could have a reason to reconsider its plans at quarterback. If he continues struggling with the same problems that plagued his previous opportunities, Indianapolis will have another difficult decision awaiting it this offseason.

Either way, the organization needs answers. For Richardson, this could be his final opportunity to prove he belongs in Indianapolis. For the Colts, it's a chance to stop delaying a decision that has been looming over the franchise for years.

The Jones experiment is reportedly over. Now, Richardson has the opportunity to write the next chapter.

articles.title: "If she's feeling different or misunderstood....": Josh Allen's wife Hailee Steinfeld makes heartfelt promise to daughter Harper with emotional life lesson
articles.summary: Hailee Steinfeld wants her and Josh Allen's daughter Harper to grow up knowing that standing out is something to celebrate, not hide.
articles.body: Hailee Steinfeld wants her and Josh Allen's daughter Harper to grow up knowing that standing out is something to celebrate, not hide. The actress recently opened up about the most important lesson she hopes to pass on to her six-month-old daughter with Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen. Speaking at the premiere of Disney’s Hexed on November 12, Steinfeld connected the film’s message of self-acceptance with her own experience of becoming a mother. Her heartfelt comments offered a glimpse into the values she hopes to build into Harper’s life.Hailee Steinfeld's message about embracing individualityFor Steinfeld, one of the biggest lessons in Hexed goes beyond its magical storyline. The film explores how qualities that make someone feel different can become their greatest strengths. It is a message the actress wants Harper to carry with her as she grows older.“A major theme in this movie is understanding that what makes you different is your greatest strength,” Steinfeld exclusively told E! News’ Lauren Herbert at the Hexed premiere Nov. 12. “If there’s any time where she is able to express that she's feeling different or misunderstood, that I can serve as a reminder that that's a great thing that … there’s something within you that is destined for something great.”The actress also drew inspiration from her character, Billie Doe, a teenage witch who refuses to give up on the life she wants. Steinfeld hopes her daughter develops the same confidence and determination.“If I can just encourage her to find that within her and be there every step of the way to support her.”The message carries a personal meaning for the actress. She began recording the Disney animated film while pregnant, making the project part of a major transition in her life.Josh Allen and Hailee Steinfeld's daughter inspires a new perspective on motherhoodSteinfeld also revealed how working on Hexed helped her understand motherhood from a different perspective. The experience made her reflect on her own relationship with her mother and the care that comes with raising a child.“This came into my life at a time that one I didn't know I needed,” she explained. "Just this whole newfound perspective on not only being a mother, but being a daughter of a protective mother, and understanding that, and understanding it wholeheartedly now, and not questioning as much as I maybe did growing up.”She described the creative journey as deeply personal and transformative.“It was moving to me this entire process,” Steinfeld continued, “and a very transformative time in my life personally and creatively as well.”Steinfeld and Allen welcomed Harper on April 2, 2026, after marrying in California in May 2025. The couple have largely kept their daughter away from the public spotlight, making the actress's comments about their parenting hopes especially meaningful.She had also spoken about looking forward to the day Harper could watch Hexed, expressing excitement about sharing the film and its characters with her daughter.For now, Steinfeld's message is simple: she wants Harper to grow up comfortable with who she is, confident in her abilities and never afraid of being different.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Travis Kelce-backed $200 million Six Flags reaches new milestone as multiple roller coaster accidents raise safety concerns
articles.summary: Six Flags Great Adventure is moving closer to giving thrill-seekers a new reason to visit in 2027.
articles.body: Six Flags Great Adventure is moving closer to giving thrill-seekers a new reason to visit in 2027. The New Jersey theme park has installed the first train of Bakunawa, a towering roller coaster expected to challenge some of the world's biggest rides. The development comes as Six Flags continues to build excitement around its attractions and future plans. With NFL star Travis Kelce also connected to the company's growth as an ambassador and investor, the amusement park brand has another high-profile name drawing attention to its business beyond the football field.Six Flags Great Adventure installs first Bakunawa roller coaster trainThe first major step towards Bakunawa's arrival is now complete. Six Flags Great Adventure in Jackson, New Jersey, has installed the first train for the new attraction as construction continues ahead of its planned 2027 opening.The green and purple train consists of five cars, each weighing 6,000 pounds. A second train, featuring a purple colour scheme, is also expected to be installed soon. Construction Manager Stephen Kolczynski described the milestone as an important moment for the project.“Today marks an exciting step forward in bringing Bakunawa to life,” said Stephen Kolczynski, Construction Manager at Six Flags Great Adventure. “With the first train now installed, our next step is connecting the cars and preparing for initial testing.The scale of the ride is expected to make it a major attraction. According to park officials, Bakunawa will rise 382 feet and reach speeds of up to 100 mph. Six Flags describes it as the world's tallest and fastest spinning coaster. Its design will include an upside-down launch, a floorless spinning experience and features aimed at delivering a different kind of thrill.The name also carries a cultural connection. Bakunawa takes inspiration from a dragon in Filipino mythology, giving the attraction an identity rooted in folklore.Travis Kelce's Six Flags connection comes amid roller coaster safety scrutinyTravis Kelce's association with Six Flags as an ambassador and investor adds a celebrity dimension to the company's efforts to attract visitors. His involvement places the Kansas City Chiefs tight end alongside a major entertainment brand as it invests in new experiences.However, the company's latest developments also come against the backdrop of a serious safety investigation at another park.Authorities have released the cause of death of Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem, 42, who fell from the Goliath roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia in October. An autopsy found that he died from blunt force injuries, including skull and bone fractures and injuries to several organs. His death was classified as accidental.Kariem was sitting beside his niece when he was ejected from the ride, striking four other guests and injuring them. The park was evacuated, and the Goliath remains closed while the investigation continues. Six Flags Over Georgia has said it plans to add seat belts alongside the existing lap restraints.As Bakunawa moves towards testing, the contrast between the excitement surrounding new rides and the importance of passenger safety remains significant for the Six Flags brand.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Tom Brady, Eli Manning Troll Each Other With Signed Jerseys from Super Bowl Rivalry in New IG Photos
articles.summary: Even though Tom Brady won seven Super Bowl titles during his legendary career, the two he didn't win against Eli Manning and the New York Giants still get a rise out of him.
articles.body:
Even though Tom Brady won seven Super Bowl titles during his legendary career, the two he didn't win against Eli Manning and the New York Giants still get a rise out of him.

Brady and Manning recently trolled each other on social media after sending signed Super Bowl jerseys to the other.

Brady and Manning played two of the most memorable Super Bowls in history, with the Giants winning both.

Super Bowl 42, in particular, is arguably the most famous game of this century because Brady and the Patriots were one win away from becoming the first team in NFL history to complete a 19-0 season.

Instead, Manning and the Giants spoiled the celebration with a 17-14 victory. Plaxico Burress caught the go-ahead touchdown with 39 seconds remaining on a play set up by David Tyree's famous helmet catch on third-and-5 earlier in the drive.

articles.title: Tyreek Hill lands a surprise GTA 6 cameo as the first athlete featured in the game, bringing his Cheetah nickname and viral celebration to Vice City
articles.summary: Tyreek Hill may be working towards an NFL comeback, but the Miami Dolphins star has found another way to stay in the spotlight.
articles.body: Tyreek Hill may be working towards an NFL comeback, but the Miami Dolphins star has found another way to stay in the spotlight. The wide receiver has made an unexpected appearance in Rockstar Games' highly anticipated GTA 6, bringing a familiar face from the football world into its fictional version of Miami. The cameo goes beyond a simple character resemblance, giving fans a few recognisable details from Hill's real-life career.Tyreek Hill appears in GTA 6 as Vice City Manatees receiverHill lends both his voice and likeness to Maleek Rivers, a wide receiver who plays for the Vice City Manatees. The fictional team draws clear inspiration from the Miami Dolphins, making the character's connection to the NFL star especially fitting.Players can spot Rivers through the game's social media feature. His profile includes Hill's famous nickname, Cheetah, along with a celebration that many football fans will remember.The character recreates Hill's viral handcuff celebration, which he performed after a pregame arrest in 2024. That detail gives the cameo a personal touch and shows how Rockstar has incorporated moments from real sports culture into its fictional world.Hill's appearance also adds another layer to GTA 6's portrayal of Vice City. The game takes inspiration from Miami's culture, entertainment and sporting identity. Bringing in a recognisable NFL personality helps make that world feel closer to the real city.Tyreek Hill's GTA 6 cameo arrives amid NFL comeback hopesThe video game appearance comes at an important point in Hill's football career. The 32-year-old is attempting to return to the NFL after suffering a serious knee injury last September. The setback interrupted his career and left questions about when he might be ready to play again.Hill spent his last four seasons with the Miami Dolphins before the team released him during the offseason. His next destination remains uncertain, although his agent, Drew Rosenhaus, has suggested that a return could happen soon.The Kansas City Chiefs and Buffalo Bills have emerged as two possible destinations in betting market discussions. Kalshi currently lists Kansas City at 17% and Buffalo at 10% as potential teams to sign the wide receiver.For now, Hill's future on the football field remains unresolved. His GTA 6 appearance, however, gives fans a different way to see the Cheetah while they wait for news about his comeback.The cameo also creates an unusual connection between two major entertainment worlds. While Hill works towards returning to professional football, his virtual counterpart is already taking the field in Vice City.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: NHL trade rumors: What does Max Sasson's move to the New York Rangers mean for the Vancouver Canucks' growing 2029 draft collection
articles.summary: The Vancouver Canucks trade Max Sasson to the New York Rangers for a fourth-round pick in the 2029 NHL Entry Draft, adding to their growing picks collection for strategic rebuilding.
articles.body: The Vancouver Canucks have completed a trade with the New York Rangers, sending forward Max Sasson to New York for a fourth-round pick in the 2029 NHL Entry Draft. The deal gives Vancouver a total of 10 picks in that draft, adding another option to its long-term rebuilding and roster development plans.Sasson leaves Vancouver after appearing in 119 NHL games, recording 21 goals and 13 assists for 34 points. The move also gives the 26-year-old forward a chance to show what he can do with the Rangers, who continue to build around future draft picks.Details on Vancouver Canucks trade of Max Sasson to New York RangersThe Vancouver Canucks have traded forward Max Sasson to the New York Rangers for a fourth-round pick in the 2029 NHL Entry Draft, giving Vancouver 10 selections in that draft.The transaction was announced by General Manager Ryan Johnson, who praised Sasson’s development in Vancouver’s organization. The forward originally signed with the Canucks as an undrafted free agent on March 26, 2023.Sasson signed with the Vancouver Canucks without being drafted and made his way into the NHL. His development also included an important contribution during Abbotsford's Calder Cup championship run.Johnson praised the forward's progress and acknowledged the organization's role in helping him reach the NHL.The Canucks executive also expressed appreciation for Sasson's contributions, wishing him success as he begins the next stage of his professional career in New York.Sasson arrives in New York with 119 career NHL appearances, all recorded with Vancouver. The Rangers receive a forward with NHL experience who has already demonstrated the ability to earn opportunities at the highest level. His next challenge will be establishing a regular role within New York's lineup.Why Vancouver Canucks are collecting 2029 draft picksThe trade reflects Vancouver's interest in increasing its future draft flexibility, and the organization has 10 picks in the 2029 NHL Entry Draft, giving them more opportunities to build up the prospect pipeline.Those picks could be used to draft young players, or in future trade packages down the line. However, the Canucks have not announced any specific plans for their expanded collection.For Ryan Johnson and the Vancouver front office, the Sasson trade represents another chance to turn an existing roster asset into future draft capital while allowing the forward to pursue a new chance with the New York Rangers.The Vancouver Canucks have traded Max Sasson to the New York Rangers for a fourth-round pick in the 2029 NHL Entry Draft. articles.title: Arch Manning Drops in Mel Kiper's New 2027 NFL Draft Big Board Rankings, Is Texas QB Even Top 5 QB?
articles.summary: Despite more late-game heroics in Texas' 22-21 win over LSU last week, Arch Manning's 2027 NFL draft prospects continue to take a hit as his overall play is leaving something to be desired.
articles.body:
Despite more late-game heroics in Texas' 22-21 win over LSU last week, Arch Manning's 2027 NFL draft prospects continue to take a hit as his overall play is leaving something to be desired.

In the latest big board ranking from ESPN's Mel Kiper Jr. , Manning dropped three spots from the previous list to No. 25 overall and No. 6 among quarterbacks.

The quarterbacks ahead of Manning on Kiper's list include Oklahoma State's Drew Mestemaker (No. 2 overall), Notre Dame's CJ Carr (No. 4), Miami's Darian Mensah (No. 7), Oregon's Dante Moore (No. 23) and South Carolina's LaNorris Sellers (No. 24).

Kiper's scouting report for Manning praises his "size, mobility and arm strength" that NFL clubs want, but inconsistent "accuracy and decision-making" are holding him back right now:

"He's going to be a tough evaluation. Watch just about any game he plays, and you'll ride the roller coaster of getting excited about his NFL ceiling and then wondering whether he's ever going to truly put it all together. Manning doesn't see the field as well as other quarterbacks on this list, and he occasionally throws off balance. And while the accuracy is better this season than it was in 2025, it still has to improve."

B/R's NFL scouting department remains optimistic about Manning's draft prospects. He is projected to go No. 4 to the New York Jets in the most recent mock released on Nov. 11.

Manning finished the LSU game 19-of-35 for 174 yards, one touchdown and three interceptions. He has thrown multiple interceptions in three of his last six games and has 10 in 289 attempts overall this season.

Mestemaker has 10 interceptions on 351 attempts this season, but he has thrown 30 touchdowns and is completing 66.4 percent of his passes.

There's also a high degree of difficulty for Mestemaker because Oklahoma State's defense ranks 112th among FBS programs in points allowed per game. Texas' defense is 16th in scoring defense.

It has been speculated that Manning could return to school in 2027 for his final year of eligibility. His performance this season certainly suggests he has a lot of work to do if he wants to be in the running for the No. 1 overall pick in the upcoming draft if he were to go to the NFL.

articles.title: Daniel Jones' Top Landing Spots Updated in New NFL Rumors After Surprise Colts Decision
articles.summary: As Daniel Jones awaits to see if he will be claimed on waivers or hit free agency after his surprise release by the Indianapolis Colts on Friday, there are two teams people in the NFL are keeping an eye on as potential landing spots for the veteran quarterback.
articles.body:
As Daniel Jones awaits to see if he will be claimed on waivers or hit free agency after his surprise release by the Indianapolis Colts on Friday, there are two teams people in the NFL are keeping an eye on as potential landing spots for the veteran quarterback.

Per The Athletic's Jonathan Jones , the New England Patriots and Arizona Cardinals were cited as clubs that could have interest in adding Jones as they seek help at the quarterback position.

Any team putting in a waiver claim on Jones would need to have $6.25 million in available cap space to fit his contract on their books. They would also assume some risk with his deal having a $10.5 million guarantee for 2027 if he were to suffer a major injury this season.

Jones' release was a surprise for many reasons, not least of which is the Colts reportedly received offers for him prior to the trade deadline but turned them down to keep him as their starter.

Now, just over one week after the deadline, the Colts are going to lose Jones for nothing in return.

According to Jonathan Jones, the deadline for teams to put in a waiver claim on Jones is Monday at 4 p.m. ET.

There are currently 22 teams with enough cap space to add Jones, though the Cardinals are not among that group. Their $2.7 million is the least available cap room in the NFL.

This isn't necessarily a huge obstacle if Arizona wanted to add Jones because a contract restructure could create room, but the Cardinals aren't really in a position where they should be pushing money into future years even with Carson Beck currently dealing with back spasms that could keep him out in Week 11.

The Patriots might be a little more desperate because Drake Maye could miss the remainder of the season after being diagnosed with a fractured right fibula. Tommy DeVito is in line to be their starter coming out of the bye next week.

New England is still in the playoff picture in the AFC with a 5-5 record, one game behind the Cleveland Browns for the final wild-card spot.

Jones' release from the Colts came after he was benched late in the fourth quarter of Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Houston Texans. The 29-year-old has thrown for 1,974 yards, seven touchdowns and 13 interceptions in 11 starts this season.

articles.title: Carmelo Anthony calls on Marlon Humphrey to do more after Baltimore 'criminals' comment: 'Apologies don't build anything. Presence does'
articles.summary: Humphrey has since apologized for his remark and the podcast episode has been deleted.
articles.body:
Basketball Hall of Famer Carmelo Anthony, who grew up in Baltimore, took to social media to call out Baltimore Ravens cornerback Marlon Humphrey for a disparaging comment he made about the city on a podcast this week.

Anthony wrote a lengthy statement on Instagram on Friday talking about losing friends to violence in the city and seeing people he loved get "swallowed by a system that was built to swallow them."

"I came up on Myrtle Avenue in West Baltimore. I saw what this city can take from you," Anthony wrote in part of his message. "I lost friends to the streets, and I watched people I loved get swallowed by a system that was built to swallow them. I know the reputation. I've heard every joke and every headline my whole life. "So when one of our own stands on our name and says the best thing Baltimore makes is criminals, and then laughs that it'll get cut out, that doesn't get cut out for me. It doesn't get cut out for the kid in Baltimore who heard it. It doesn't get cut out for the mother working two jobs to keep her son off the corner. And it doesn't get cut for the man who did his time, came home, and is fighting every day to be seen as more than his worst moment. "Marlon, I see the apology. I'll take it, man to man. But Baltimore has been apologized to its whole life. Apologies don't build anything. Presence does."

"I came up on Myrtle Avenue in West Baltimore. I saw what this city can take from you," Anthony wrote in part of his message. "I lost friends to the streets, and I watched people I loved get swallowed by a system that was built to swallow them. I know the reputation. I've heard every joke and every headline my whole life.

"So when one of our own stands on our name and says the best thing Baltimore makes is criminals, and then laughs that it'll get cut out, that doesn't get cut out for me. It doesn't get cut out for the kid in Baltimore who heard it. It doesn't get cut out for the mother working two jobs to keep her son off the corner. And it doesn't get cut for the man who did his time, came home, and is fighting every day to be seen as more than his worst moment.

"Marlon, I see the apology. I'll take it, man to man. But Baltimore has been apologized to its whole life. Apologies don't build anything. Presence does."

Humphrey initially made the comment on an episode this week of "The Marlon Humphrey Show." When asked what Baltimore was best at making, Humphrey mentioned "The Star-Spangled Banner" and National Bohemian beer before making a derogatory comment that has received widespread criticism.

"What is Baltimore best at making?" Humphrey pondered . "They're best at making criminals."

Humphrey, who has spent his entire 10-year career in Baltimore, acknowledged the comments with an apology on Wednesday . Baltimore Mayor Brandon Scott responded on social media , saying in a statement that Humphrey's "verbal apology is not enough" and invited Humphrey to sit down with him and talk with a group of Baltimoreans "who have re-entered into our community and are now preventing others from making the mistakes they made."

The podcast episode has since been deleted and the cornerback was made inactive this week for the Ravens' game against the Carolina Panthers.

As part of his statement, Anthony challenged Humphrey to get out into the city and do more to better things.

"I put my Time, Energy, and Resources in Baltimore because I want kids to have somebody who believe in them," Anthony wrote. "That's the job when you wear this city on your chest. You don't get to rep Baltimore on Sundays and talk about it like an outside on Wednesday."

articles.title: 18-year-old UGA football commit's sudden death takes another heartbreaking turn as family reveals his final moments
articles.summary: The family of Marcellus Young Casario has shared a painful account of the 18-year-old’s final hours, offering details about the emergency that claimed his
articles.body: The family of Marcellus Young Casario has shared a painful account of the 18-year-old’s final hours, offering details about the emergency that claimed his life on November 13. The Georgia football commit had reportedly felt unwell before going back to sleep early that Friday. His loved ones said he got water from a fountain, returned to bed and never woke up. The cause of death has not been established, and the family says it is still waiting for answers.Family describes Marcellus Young Casario’s final hoursIn a statement to 247Sports, the family said Young Casario was “not feeling well, woke up early Friday, got a drink of water from the water fountain, went back to bed and never woke up.” The account does not explain what caused the emergency.The family also acknowledged the concern from people who knew the teenager, while asking for privacy. “While we are trying to navigate all of this with as much privacy as possible, we know there are many wonderful people in Marcellus’ life who cared so much about him and are wondering how this could happen,” they said. “Unfortunately we do not yet know.”An autopsy has been completed, 247Sports reported, but toxicology results may take up to three months. His father, Devin Casario, previously told CBC that his son had experienced some heart issues. That history does not establish what triggered the emergency.For now, the family has shared what it knows while medical professionals and authorities work toward a clearer account of what happened.Rabun Gap and Georgia remember a young defensive linemanKnown as “Mar” to friends, Young Casario attended Rabun Gap-Nacoochee School in northeast Georgia. He arrived from Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada, as a junior and had spent two years at the boarding school. He played defensive line and was due to graduate in December.Rabun Gap said he “tragically passed away” after “a sudden medical emergency.” The school described him as “a natural leader, a loyal friend, and a standout student-athlete,” adding that he quickly became a cornerstone of its community.His teammates paid tribute earlier this week with fireworks and a ceremony before securing a place in the NCISSA State Championships. The team fell short of the title, but the tribute gave classmates a chance to remember him.Young Casario had committed to play for the University of Georgia, his next step after Rabun Gap. His family said they “have full confidence that the school and law enforcement will do everything in their power to determine what happened.” They also stressed that he “did not take his own life and did not have the Covid vaccine.” Those are statements from his loved ones, not an explanation of his death.“He had an incredible future that he had worked hard for with many sacrifices along the way,” they added.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: New Daniel Jones Rumors on Ravens' Trade Offer Colts Rejected Before Cutting QB for Richardson
articles.summary: The Baltimore Ravens reportedly made the Indianapolis Colts an offer for quarterback Daniel Jones prior to the NFL trade deadline, only for the Colts to decline it.
articles.body:
The Baltimore Ravens reportedly made the Indianapolis Colts an offer for quarterback Daniel Jones prior to the NFL trade deadline, only for the Colts to decline it.

According to Tom Pelissero of The Ringer, the Ravens offered the Colts a mid-round pick swap "that would've returned a pick to Indianapolis if Baltimore made the playoffs."

The Colts' decision to turn down that reported offer looms large now since Indianapolis surprisingly released Jones on Friday, making Anthony Richardson Sr. the starter for the remainder of the season.

Pelissero noted that the Colts also had talks with the Minnesota Vikings regarding Jones, but the Colts "still weren't particularly interested in listening."

Both Baltimore and Minnesota moved on to other options after speaking with the Colts, as the Ravens acquired Jacoby Brissett from the Arizona Cardinals and the Vikings got Kirk Cousins from the Las Vegas Raiders.

While it can be argued that the Colts erred in not getting something for Jones if they were just going to cut him a couple of weeks later, his poor play essentially forced the organization to make a change.

After going 8-5 as a starter and throwing for 3,101 yards, 19 touchdowns and eight interceptions last season before tearing his Achilles, Jones was nowhere near as good in 11 starts this season.

In addition to posting a 3-8 record, Jones threw for 1,974 yards, seven touchdowns and a league-high 13 picks.

According to Pelissero, Colts owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon supported the initial decision to stick with Jones, as well as the decision to replace him with Richardson.

The move to release Jones rather than keeping him as a backup was reportedly made because the Colts "have too much respect for Jones to make him hang around as the emergency no. 3 QB or run the scout team."

They reportedly also could no longer see a path toward bringing him back as the starter next season, plus the $10.51 million injury guarantee in his contract for 2027 could have created issues had he gotten injured down the stretch.

Cutting Jones now rather than waiting until after the start of the new league year does have a significant financial impact on the Colts since the $35.2 million in dead money incurred from parting ways with him will count against the team's salary cap in 2027 rather than getting deferred until 2028, per Pelissero.

Ultimately, despite being 3-8 and having very little chance of reaching the playoffs, there is also no real upside to the Colts losing down the stretch.

That is because they traded their 2027 first-round pick to the New York Jets for cornerback Sauce Gardner last season.

As such, the Colts are motivated to win games for the remainder of the season, and the decision to cut Jones suggests the team's decision-makers believe Richardson gives them the best chance to win.

articles.title: New Cowboys Rumors on Brian Schottenheimer, Christian Parker's Hot Seats After Major Decision on DC
articles.summary: With Christian Parker's role as Dallas Cowboys defensive coordinator being diminished after losing play-calling responsibilities, the spotlight on head coach Brian Schottenheimer is brighter than ever with seven games remaining in the regular season.
articles.body:
With Christian Parker's role as Dallas Cowboys defensive coordinator being diminished after losing play-calling responsibilities, the spotlight on head coach Brian Schottenheimer is brighter than ever with seven games remaining in the regular season.

Per The Athletic's Jonathan Jones , Parker is expected to leave the Cowboys at the end of this season to coach elsewhere in 2027 and Schottenheimer could be coaching to save his job in part because he gave a "strong vote of confidence" to hiring Parker in the offseason.

"This was a move for Schotty to save face," one person told Jones about the move to take play-calling duties on defense away from Parker.

NFL Head Coaching Changes That Must Be Made 🏈

Schottenheimer announced on Wednesday that Pettine, who joined the Cowboys staff during the season prior to Week 5 as a senior defensive assistant, would handle play-calling on that side of the ball going forward.

Parker will retain his title as defensive coordinator and help put together game plans, but he admitted during a press conference on Thursday this is "not an ideal situation" for him and he did initially consider leaving the Cowboys altogether before deciding to stay.

The change came in the wake of Dallas' 46-40 loss to the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday in which the defense allowed 584 yards, the most in a home game in franchise history .

Schottenheimer is in his second season as Cowboys head coach and the same issues that plagued his debut year remain a problem. The Cowboys went 7-9-1 in 2025 thanks primarily to a defense that allowed the most points in the NFL.

Despite several attempts to fix that side of the ball, including using three first-round picks between the trade for Quinnen Williams and selections of Caleb Downs and Malachi Lawrence, the Cowboys rank 30th in points allowed per game this season.

One potential feather in Schottenheimer's cap is his background was as an offensive coach. The Cowboys rank fifth in points per game going into Week 11, so he could use that as an argument to retain his job in 2027.

It could also help Schottenheimer if Pettine is able to get the defense to turn things around. The Cowboys (4-6) are two games out of a playoff spot in the NFC, but they have two winnable games coming up against the Tennessee Titans on Sunday and Philadelphia Eagles on Thanksgiving Day.

articles.title: After Daniel Jones Cut, Shane Steichen's Hot Seat as Colts HC Addressed in New NFL Rumors
articles.summary: Having already fired Chris Ballard as general manager and releasing Daniel Jones amid a tough season for the Indianapolis Colts, Shane Steichen's status as head coach seems more precarious than ever.
articles.body:
Having already fired Chris Ballard as general manager and releasing Daniel Jones amid a tough season for the Indianapolis Colts, Shane Steichen's status as head coach seems more precarious than ever.

Per The Athletic's Jonathan Jones , many people in the NFL believe Steichen won't be retained by the Colts at the end of this season and he will coach somewhere else, either as a head coach or offensive coordinator, in 2027.

It wouldn't be a surprise to see some parting of ways between Steichen and the Colts. He and Ballard were both rumored to be on the heat seat at the end of last season before the Colts opted to bring both of them back.

Ballard only made it through five games this season before he was fired. Steichen at least appears likely to finish out the season, but he's on track to have his third consecutive losing record in his fourth year.

Steichen's only non-losing season with the Colts thus far was his first year in 2023 when they finished 9-8.

The Colts' search for a new general manager would also seem to have implications for Steichen. Teams typically like to give a GM the chance to hire the head coach so there is symmetry between the two parties.

Moving on from Steichen would allow the Colts to completely start over at a time when the franchise needs a reset. They have already started the process by trading veteran players like Quenton Nelson, DeForest Buckner and Keenan Allen.

Jonathan Taylor remains the big domino still standing, though Jones noted the new general manager will be given the option to keep the star running back or trade him in the offseason.

The Colts (3-8) are in a brutal spot right now with no first-round pick in the 2027 draft stemming from the Sauce Gardner trade. They have acquired multiple middle-round picks, with eight projected between rounds three and five, to fill out their depth.

Steichen could also benefit from a change of scenery if the Colts decide to go in a different direction. He was a highly-regarded offensive coordinator following his two-year stint in the role with the Philadelphia Eagles from 2021 to '22.

At just 41 years old, Steichen has plenty of time to rebuild his value if he leaves the Colts and has to take a coordinator role next season. It's also plausible he could impress in interviews enough to receive head-coaching offers given how tough the situation in Indianapolis has been this season.

articles.title: New Patriots Rumors on Jimmy Garoppolo amid Daniel Jones Buzz After Drake Maye's Injury Update
articles.summary: Despite starting quarterback Drake Maye potentially being in line to miss the remainder of the season, a reunion with free-agent quarterback Jimmy Garoppolo is reportedly not on the New England Patriots' radar currently.
articles.body:
Despite starting quarterback Drake Maye potentially being in line to miss the remainder of the season, a reunion with free-agent quarterback Jimmy Garoppolo is reportedly not on the New England Patriots' radar currently.

According to Tom Pelissero of The Ringer, there has been "no serious discussion" within the Pats organization about signing Garoppolo even though he is one of the most accomplished signal-callers available.

Per ESPN's Mike Reiss and Adam Schefter , Maye is out indefinitely with a fractured fibula, and while it is possible he could return late in the season, it is far from guaranteed.

If the Patriots want to add a veteran quarterback to potentially take the starting job from Tommy DeVito while Maye is on the mend, Jonathan Jones of The Athletic reported that sources he spoke to "pointed immediately" to New England as an option for Daniel Jones after he was shockingly released by the Indianapolis Colts on Friday.

At 5-5, the Patriots are still in the thick of the playoff race in the AFC, trailing the 6-4 Cleveland Browns by only one game for the final wild-card spot.

Because of that, it is fair to wonder if they will get aggressive in trying to find a more viable option at quarterback than DeVito.

The 28-year-old DeVito has appeared in 15 games and made eight starts with the New York Giants and Patriots during his NFL career.

His numbers don't jump off the page, but they aren't poor either, as he has completed 63.4 percent of his passes for 1,490 yards, nine touchdowns and four interceptions.

Replacing Maye early in last week's 35-10 loss to the Detroit Lions in Germany, DeVito largely struggled, though, going 12-of-24 for 81 yards with one touchdown and one interception.

Per Pelissero, there is "optimism" within the Patriots organization that DeVito will give the Pats a chance to win their next game against the Los Angeles Chargers on Nov. 29, coming off a bye week.

When Maye got injured, the Patriots were in a tough spot since the trade deadline had already passed, meaning the only real way to bring in another quarterback would be to sign one that is already a free agent.

Garoppolo instantly emerged as a potential option because of his 85 career appearances and 64 career starts with the Patriots, San Francisco 49ers, Las Vegas Raiders and Los Angeles Rams.

The 35-year-old Garoppolo is an impressive 43-21 as a starter, and he even led the 49ers to a Super Bowl berth in 2019.

Jimmy G spent his first three seasons in New England as Tom Brady's backup, going 2-0 in two starts for the Pats in 2016.

Garoppolo made only one start over two seasons as the Rams' backup in 2024 and 2025, though, and he went unsigned this past offseason.

Given how long it has been since he has last played meaningful snaps, it is fair to wonder if he would be any more effective than DeVito.

Despite his struggles to the tune of seven touchdown passes and 13 interceptions this season, Jones stands out as a more attractive option, having started 11 games this season and 13 last season in Indianapolis.

articles.title: New Puka Nacua Rumors on Injury, Return Timeline Ahead of Rams' Decision on Contract in Free Agency
articles.summary: Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua got multiple medical opinions after suffering an MCL tear, and all of them recommended surgery, per The Ringer and Netflix's Tom Pelissero, who reported the news in The Sweep newsletter and further noted there is "virtually no chance" the two-time Pro Bowler will return in 2026.
articles.body:
Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua got multiple medical opinions after suffering an MCL tear, and all of them recommended surgery, per The Ringer and Netflix's Tom Pelissero, who reported the news in The Sweep newsletter and further noted there is "virtually no chance" the two-time Pro Bowler will return in 2026.

"As for Nacua's injury, he sought several medical opinions for the MCL tear, which he initially gave a week or so to see how it would heal on its own, hoping he could rehab and return. But the final medical guidance was unanimous: Surgery was necessary. It has been just a few days since, but it appears there's virtually no chance that Nacua will be on the field again this season.

Predicting Next Big NFL Contract Extensions 🔮

"His focus now is on getting healthy entering a big offseason in which the Rams figure to make a push to sign Nacua to a contract extension—one of many major organizational decisions ahead on members of the team's vaunted 2023 draft class, all of whom remain unsigned for 2027."

Nacua, an impending free agent, caught 70 passes for 715 yards and four touchdowns in seven games this season.

In his final 2026 contest, Nacua caught 14 passes for 150 yards and a touchdown in a 20-13 road win over the Washington Commanders.

Unfortunately, Nacua suffered multiple injuries after taking a hit following a handoff late in the fourth quarter. McVay initially told reporters that Nacua suffered an MCL and PCL sprain and turf toe as well.

Initially, McVay said it appeared Nacua would go on injured reserve, but he then said the Rams weren't doing so because of roster mechanics . Ultimately, the Rams did place Nacua on IR on Nov. 12, meaning he would miss at least four games but be eligible to return before the end of the regular season.

On Thursday, the NFL announced that Nacua would be suspended three games for violating the league's personal conduct policy. As ESPN's Adam Schefter noted, "a player's injury designation does not delay discipline or prevent a suspension from being served."

Then on Friday, McVay told reporters that Nacua opted for surgery last Tuesday and would be out a "couple months."

In theory, Nacua could return if the Rams make a playoff run (of note, Wild Card Weekend is Jan 16-18, 2027). However, McVay said "that would be getting way far ahead, so haven't thought about that."

"It's a couple months is kind of really where it's at, which, in my mind, I think what's healthy to do is to say that you're planning on not having him," McVay said, per rams.com staff writer Zach Edwards.

All signs, ultimately, point toward Nacua's 2026 season being over. The question is whether his Rams tenure is as well. Of course, one can surmise that the Rams would want him back. He's posted a 17-game season average of 128 catches and 1,635 yards over his four-year career, easily making him one of the league's most productive players.

In the meantime, Nacua will rehab his injuries in hopes of returning 100 percent soon enough, and the 6-4 Rams continue their fight for the playoffs. They'll enjoy a bye week before hosting the Green Bay Packers on Thanksgiving Eve.

articles.title: Titans DE Jaylen Harrell Hospitalized After 'Serious' Car Crash
articles.summary: Tennessee Titans defensive end Jaylen Harrell has been hospitalized in Tampa, Florida after being involved in a "serious" car accident, per a team statement released on Saturday.
articles.body:
Tennessee Titans defensive end Jaylen Harrell has been hospitalized in Tampa, Florida after being involved in a "serious" car accident, per a team statement released on Saturday.

"Yesterday, Jaylen Harrell was involved in a serious car accident that resulted in him being taken to the hospital in his hometown of Tampa, Florida. We have been in constant communication with Jaylen's family and are still working to gather more information. At this time, Jaylen remains in the hospital and continues to receive care. We ask that Jaylen and his family's privacy be respected at this time. We will provide an update when appropriate."

Harrell, who was born and raised in Tampa, Florida, was away from the team as he rehabs a season-ending torn ACL suffered in this year's preseason opener against the San Francisco 49ers on Aug. 13.

Harrell played high school ball at Berkeley Preparatory School. The 247Sports Composite list ranked Harrell as a highly regarded 4-star prospect.

He starred at Michigan before the Tennessee Titans selected him with a seventh-round pick in the 2024 NFL draft. Harrell started in his final two seasons and led the 2023 undefeated, national championship-winning team with 6.5 sacks. He earned All-Big Ten honorable mention honors for his efforts in his senior season.

Harrell played all 34 games (two starts) for the Titans over the 2024 and 2025 seasons. He amassed 4.5 sacks, eight quarterback hits and 25 tackles (14 solo) in 2025. Harrell shined over the final four games with 3.5 sacks (five quarterback hits).

articles.title: Nicolas Cage, Raiders Owner Mark Davis Address Depictions of John Madden, Al Davis in 'Madden' Movie
articles.summary: Actor Nicolas Cage responded to criticism of his portrayal of John Madden and Las Vegas Raiders owner Mark Davis offered some criticism of his own regarding how his late father, Al Davis, was depicted in the newly released movie Madden this week.
articles.body:
Actor Nicolas Cage responded to criticism of his portrayal of John Madden and Las Vegas Raiders owner Mark Davis offered some criticism of his own regarding how his late father, Al Davis, was depicted in the newly released movie Madden this week.

The film, which is exclusive to the Prime Video streaming platform, has received largely negative reviews since it debuted Wednesday, including a 14 percent on Rotten Tomatoes .

Speaking to Kirsten Chuba of The Hollywood Reporter this week, Cage explained why his performance as Madden may not have hit the mark for everyone.

"That's what acting's about. I'm not an impressionist, I'm not [Madden impersonator] Frank Caliendo," Cage said. "I lean more towards being a surrealist, meaning I like to get a concept of a personality and then dig deep and see what I can locate emotionally with my imagination and my psyche and filter it through the cadence and the appearance, within reason, of John Madden. I'm trying to give you an evocation, more or less, or an interpretation."

Cage went on to divulge that he accepted the role of the famed and beloved Raiders head coach and NFL analyst because "I'm someone that likes to stay out of his comfort zone and take a risk, I said yes, because that would be a transformation."

Davis, who has been the Raiders' principal owner since the death of his father in 2011, had a bigger issue with the manner in which the Al Davis character came across in Madden .

In an interview with Callie Fin of USA Today , Davis said, "As far as representations of my dad, yeah, that hurts, and I did the best I could to protect him. It's absolutely a crime that they're able to treat people that have passed away and characterize them in ways that are unfair, and there's nobody around to protect their legacies. It's just unfair. I don't know what the purpose of the movie was to be real honest."

The late Al Davis was the Raiders' principal owner from 1972 until his death in 2011, and he enjoyed enormous success during that time, winning three Super Bowls, including one with Madden as his head coach.

Played by Christian Bale in the movie, the Al Davis character fell short of the man Mark Davis knew.

The younger Davis was particularly upset by a scene which features Al Davis dismissing Madden's concern for New England Patriots wide receiver Darryl Stingley, who was paralyzed during a 1978 preseason game against the Raiders.

"One of the main legacies of my father was how much he took care of people, whether it was on the Raiders or other teams," Davis said. "People that were ill or needed help or whatever. He helped so many players on other teams that it's incredible. And he did it quietly.

"And for them to put in the Darryl Stingley incident, that my dad was trying to talk John out of going to see him—that was just such a hurt to me personally, because that's my father's legacy, is how he treated people. No matter whether they were Raiders or not, he cared about people. That's one of the redeeming qualities of my father throughout his life. And I just thought it was totally unfair for them to portray it that way."

Al Davis is perhaps best known for his, "Just win, baby," mantra, but Mark Davis suggested there was more to his father than on-field success.

articles.title: "Someday when Harper’s a little older”: Hailee Steinfeld on her heartfelt dream for her daughter as Josh Allen enjoys an impressive season
articles.summary: Josh Allen, the popular four time Pro Bowler, has led the Buffalo Bills to an impressive start in the new season as his wife, the BAFTA nominated actress
articles.body: Josh Allen, the popular four time Pro Bowler, has led the Buffalo Bills to an impressive start in the new season as his wife, the BAFTA nominated actress Hailee Steinfeld, has quickly gone back to work after giving birth to their daughter, Harper. While Josh Allen remains focused on his career, Hailee Steinfeld has reflected on a dream she has for her daughter.Hailee Steinfeld reflected on what she wanted to do with her daughter, Harper, as Josh Allen remains busy with his commitmentsLast month, in her newsletter Beau Society, the “Sinners” actress Hailee Steinfeld reflected on her trip to New York City as she wrote, “My favorite New York City pastime is looking out the window. On Tuesday morning, I was in a big black SUV heading to my early fittings. Instead of grabbing my phone or prepping for my interviews, I found myself staring out the window, watching all the people on their morning commute. I wondered what they do for work, what their life stories are, and where everyone’s finding these great little fall jackets. (One of my favorite things about New York: No matter the weather, you’re bound to see an unexpectedly great accessory.)”She added, “There are so many walks of life here. So much happening all the time. So many stories. So many different outcomes to certain scenarios, sliding-door moments, unfolding every minute on every side street and crosswalk. But sometimes it takes a little presence — when you’re sitting in early-morning traffic with no control over how fast you’re moving — to appreciate it.”The BAFTA nominated actress continued, “Someday, when Harper’s a little older, I’ll bring her to the city. I imagine we’ll play “I Spy” from the backseat, telling each other about all the little things that catch our eye.”Josh Allen balances fatherhood alongside commitments on the field amid a promising start in the ongoing seasonOver the last few months, while both Josh Allen and his wife, Hailee Steinfeld, have remained private about their daughter and have also stayed away from sharing her pictures on social media, the two have shared various anecdotes from their new lives as parents.In many of his interviews, the Buffalo Bills’ quarterback Josh Allen has opened up about how he is prioritizing his family life while also being committed to the team.Amid a brief injury scare, Josh Alen has remained focused on his performance as he has led the team to 8 wins and just 1 loss in the new season.Despite a promising start, the four time Pro Bowler Josh Allen has reflected on how he wants his team to perform better on the field.For now, all eyes remain on the Buffalo Bills as the team gears up to face the Miami Dolphins in the next few hours.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Titans defensive end Jaylen Harrell involved in serious traffic accident on Friday, remains hospitalized in Florida
articles.summary: Harrell suffered a season-ending torn ACL in August and was ruled out for the 2026 season.
articles.body:
The Tennessee Titans announced on Saturday that linebacker Jaylen Harrell was involved in a serious traffic accident on Friday.

Harrell was in his hometown of Tampa, Florida, when the accident occurred. The Titans said he remains hospitalized. The team is gathering more information and said it will provide an update when appropriate.

Harrell hasn't played for Tennessee this season. He tore his ACL in the preseason and was placed on season-ending injured reserve.

Tennessee selected the 24-year-old in the seventh round of the 2024 NFL Draft. He finished his rookie season with 13 combined tackles. Harrell improved last season, starting two of his 17 games. He finished with 25 combined tackles, including 4.5 sacks and a forced fumble.

With Harrell sidelined for the season, Tennessee defensive end Jacob Martin has played in nine games and leads the team with 7.5 sacks.

The Titans have been missing Harrell's depth. The team's second-leading tackle, Jeffery Simmons, was traded to the Chicago Bears on Oct. 29. Tennessee's next active sack leader behind Martin is Jermaine Johnson II, with three sacks.

articles.title: Fiona the Hippo Honored by Bengals, Cincinnati Teams After Zoo Announces Her Death
articles.summary: Cincinnati's local sports teams are paying tribute to a late icon of the Cincinnati Zoo.
articles.body:
Cincinnati's local sports teams are paying tribute to a late icon of the Cincinnati Zoo.

Cincinnati Bearcats fans were the latest to honor Fiona the hippo with numerous signs in the crowd during Saturday's game vs. Colorado.

Earlier in the week, the Bengals shared a post in honor of Fiona the hippo after the zoo announced her death on Thursday afternoon.

The Cincinnati Reds and FC Cincinnati also honored Fiona:

FC Cincinnati defender Nick Hagglund later dedicated Thursday's MLS playoff victory over Orlando City SC to Fiona:

The Cincinnati Zoo announced Fiona died "after she ingested a hat that ended up in her habitat by accident last week."

"Despite multiple attempts to move the hat out of her system, it was ultimately too much to overcome," the zoo said.

Fiona first gained national fame when the Cincinnati Zoo's social media accounts chronicled her growth from just 29 pounds after being born prematurely in 2017. She would have been 10 years old this January.

articles.title: Carson Beck Injured, Latest Updates on Cardinals QB's Status vs. Chiefs for NFL Week 11
articles.summary: The Arizona Cardinals will turn to veteran backup quarterback Josh Johnson when they face the Kansas City Chiefs.
articles.body:
The Arizona Cardinals will turn to veteran backup quarterback Josh Johnson when they face the Kansas City Chiefs.

Carson Beck has been downgraded to out for Sunday because of back spasms. On Friday, Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur told reporters Friday he was preparing to start Johnson after Beck did not practice due to a back injury.

After not being listed on the injury report Wednesday, Beck was added on Thursday, as he was a limited participant in practice.

After the Cardinals traded Jacoby Brissett to the Baltimore Ravens and Gardner Minshew suffered a season-ending UCL injury, Beck made his first career NFL start against the Los Angeles Rams this past Sunday.

The third-round pick out of Miami struggled to get much going in a 34-6 loss to the Rams, completing 11 of his 18 passing attempts for 108 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions, while also getting sacked five times.

Arizona signed Johnson off the Cincinnati Bengals' practice squad following the Minshew injury, and he may now be in line to start just a couple of weeks later.

Johnson, 40, has spent time with numerous teams over the course of his lengthy NFL career, and the Cardinals could become the eighth different team with which he has seen regular-season action.

Over 50 career NFL games, including 11 starts, Johnson is 2-9, and he has completed 58.7 percent of his passing attempts for 2,669 yards, 14 touchdowns and 18 interceptions.

Johnson made two starts for the Washington Commanders last season, posting a 1-1 record.

Even with Beck in the lineup, the 3-7 Cardinals were going to be massive underdogs on the road against a 7-2 Chiefs team that is battling with the Denver Broncos for the AFC West lead.

articles.title: Cardinals QB Carson Beck ruled out, 40-year-old Josh Johnson to start vs. Chiefs
articles.summary: The 40-year-old Johnson is on the 15th team in his NFL career.
articles.body:
The Arizona Cardinals are turning to their fourth quarterback of the season.

On Saturday, the team ruled out quarterback Carson Beck for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs. Beck has been dealing with back spasms and did not practice on Friday. Head coach Mike LaFleur said that the team was preparing for Josh Johnson to be the team's starter for Week 11.

Beck, who is a rookie, was thrust into the role of starter after Gardner Minshew went on injured reserve with a torn UCL . The Cardinals' original starter, Jacoby Brissett, was traded to the Baltimore Ravens after being benched for Minshew mid-game the week before.

Beck had been listed as questionable on Friday's injury report.

LaFleur said that this is an issue that Beck has dealt with before, but wasn't able to provide a clear timeline for a return.

In the meantime, the 40-year-old Johnson, who was signed off the Cincinnati Bengals' practice squad after the Minshew injury, will step up for Sunday's matchup against the Chiefs. At 40 years, 191 days, Johnson will be the second-oldest non-specialist to appear in a game for the Cardinals behind only Jim Thorpe (41 years, 185 days old), according to the team.

The itinerant backup quarterback also has some history with LaFleur: Johnson and LaFleur's careers overlapped in 2021, when both were with the New York Jets (LaFleur was an offensive coordinator at the time). LaFleur had high praise for Johnson, noting some of the reasons he's been able to keep his career going this long.

"If it is Josh, I've called plays for him before, and had a really great experience calling plays for him," LaFleur said. "He is incredible in the quarterback room, he's incredible for the starters. He's incredible for young quarterbacks, in terms of the way he sees the game, his energy, his positivity, how he keeps it real. He's mature. And he can still sling it. … If that's the route that ends up happening, let's go."

Arizona is the 15th NFL franchise that Johnson has been a part of in his career, as the veteran quarterback has bounced between half of the teams in the league. Across 16 seasons, he has only started 11 games in his NFL career.

articles.title: How Much Money 49ers, Vikings Spent on Mexico City Game & More NFL Rumors on International Schedule
articles.summary: The San Francisco 49ers reportedly spent in the "low seven figures" to train at Air Force Academy in Colorado Springs, Colorado this week in order to prepare for the 7,352-foot elevation at Mexico City's Estadio Banorte, where they'll play the Minnesota Vikings in a Sunday Night Football matchup tomorrow.
articles.body:
The San Francisco 49ers reportedly spent in the "low seven figures" to train at Air Force Academy in Colorado Springs, Colorado this week in order to prepare for the 7,352-foot elevation at Mexico City's Estadio Banorte, where they'll play the Minnesota Vikings in a Sunday Night Football matchup tomorrow.

Jonathan Jones of The Athletic reported that news, and he also noted the Vikings spent in the "high six figures" to bring in "high-altitude training equipment" to the team's Eagan, Minnesota facilities.

The 49ers-Vikings matchup will be the last of nine international games this season, but that number is expected to rise. Per the Associated Press in May:

"NFL owners on Tuesday approved an increase to 10 international games beyond this upcoming season. That's the maximum number of games the league can play outside the United States per the collective bargaining agreement with the NFL Players Association.

"NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell has said 16 international games is the goal."

Jones reported that the "expectation" is the NFL will hit 10 games in 2027. He then provided some insight into where those games may be.

"Europe will obviously get the majority of games. Dublin hosted a great game in 2025 between the Pittsburgh Steelers and Vikings, and the league would like to get back to Ireland as early as next year. The Germany games have been a success, and I could see the league holding multiple games there next year. The pact with Brazil means the league will hold two more games there in four years, possibly as early as next year. The league could hold as many as two more games in Australia over the next three years. Asia — specifically Japan — has been floated by commissioner Roger Goodell as the next frontier, but that won't be in 2027."

In 2026, the NFL made its debut in Australia. Games also took place in London (three), Paris, Madrid, Munich and Rio de Janeiro.

Now Mexico City closes out this year's international slate. Adjusting to the altitude is a big transition for both teams, so it's no surprise both are spending lots of money to prepare for this game.

In addition, it's a huge matchup for both teams and could determine the NFC's No. 1 seed.

The 8-1 49ers currently hold down first in the conference and have a comfortable three-game lead in the loss column over the Los Angeles Rams and Seattle Seahawks in the NFC West.

The 7-2 Vikings are in a three-way tie for first in the NFC North with the Detroit Lions and Chicago Bears.

Kickoff is set for 8:20 p.m. ET on Sunday.

articles.title: Titans Player Jaylen Harrell Hospitalized After ‘Serious Car Accident’ in His Florida Hometown
articles.summary: “At this time, Jaylen remains in the hospital and continues to receive care,” the NFL team wrote in a statement
articles.body:
Tennessee Titans defensive end Jaylen Harrell has been hospitalized after being involved in a "serious car crash"

The crash occurred on Friday, Nov. 20, in his hometown of Tampa, Fla.

"We have been in constant communication with Jaylen's family and are still working to gather more information," the NFL team said in a statement

Tennessee Titans defensive end Jaylen Harrell has been hospitalized after being involved in a "serious car crash" in Florida.

On Saturday, Nov. 21, the NFL team announced that the 24-year-old athlete was "involved in a serious car accident that resulted in him being taken to the hospital in his hometown of Tampa, Florida," one day prior, per the NFL .

"We have been in constant communication with Jaylen's family and are still working to gather more information," the team said in a statement. "At this time, Jaylen remains in the hospital and continues to receive care."

While the team did not provide any details surrounding the crash, they asked that "Jaylen and his family's privacy be respected at this time."

"We will provide an update when appropriate," the Titans added.

Follow your favorite athletes on and off the field with PEOPLE's free sports newsletter — sign up now!

Harrell attended Berkeley Preparatory School in Tampa before going on to play football at the University of Michigan, where he was part of the 2023 national championship team, per The Athletic . He also won a College Football Playoff national championship and a Big Ten honorable mention that same year.

The Titans selected Harrell in the seventh round of the 2024 draft, according to ESPN . He finished his rookie season with 13 combined tackles.

In August, Harrell was diagnosed with a torn ACL and placed on season-ending injured reserve after the team's preseason opener against the San Francisco 49ers.

The football star appeared in all 34 games for the Titans over his first two seasons and started the team's final two games of the 2025 campaign, per the NFL. Throughout his career, Harrell has had 4.5 sacks (four of which came over Tennessee's last five games last year), 38 tackles, eight quarterback hits, seven tackles for loss and a forced fumble.

Harrell's father, James, also played eight seasons in the NFL, including seven with the Detroit Lions and one with the Kansas City Chiefs.

articles.title: Jets Expected to Be Involved in Bidding War for Top QB
articles.summary: The New York Jets are expected to be involved in a bidding war in an attempt to win the Drew Mestemaker sweepstakes. The post Jets Expected to Be Involved in...
articles.body:
ESPN NFL Insider Adam Schefter said a bidding war is expected for the No. 1 overall pick, and the New York Jets should be prominently involved.

"There is going to be an auction, I believe, for the No. 1 pick for the right to draft Drew Mestemaker," the ESPN NFL Insider said on the "Adam Schefter Podcast." "Dolphins, Jets, Cardinals, Browns, whoever. Someone's going to want to trade up with the Titans or the Chargers."

Tennessee currently holds the top pick in the 2027 NFL Draft.

"Tennessee, I believe, even at the 1-hole, would stick with Cam Ward," Schefter said on the podcast via ESPN. "I think that there's enough belief and conviction within that organization that they feel like right now — and there's still eight games to go for the Titans this season — they feel like they have a quarterback here. Cam Ward's had three head coaches and three coordinators in under two years. They want to give him some consistency."

For a bidding war to ensue, there has to be a clear-cut top QB prospect.

Longtime NFL scout Daniel Jeremiah said on "The Rich Eisen Show" that Mestemaker is the top guy.

"I think the quarterbacks are starting to crystallize a little bit for me in terms of the tiers and the company they're keeping. I would have Mestemaker in his own tier. Then I would have [CJ] Carr and [Darian] Mensah in that next tier, and I have the same grade on both of them. We will watch it throughout the year. I've watched that tape to the day of both of them and their matchup against each other, and I thought they both did good things," Jeremiah told Rich Eisen.

"[Trinidad] Chambliss has taken on a little bit of water. He hasn't played as well over the last three or four games. He is in that next tier, and then it's the wildcard tier for me, which is [Brendan] Sorsby, Arch [Manning] what does he do- and [LaNorris] Sellers as the just ridiculous athlete who is starting to come along a little bit. Those are kind of the distinct tiers for me, and we will kind of sort those out as we go," Jeremiah added.

If the green and white doesn't organically land the top pick in the draft, they have the resources to do what is necessary to get there.

The Jets have three first-round picks in the 2027 NFL Draft. No other team can match that capital in April's draft.

Now the only reason for the Jets to potentially move up is if there is a quarterback they are in love with. If that player doesn't exist, then it would behoove the Jets to stick and pick. Let the draft fall to them.

There are still seven games left in the 2026 regular season for the green and white. So keep a bookmark on Tankathon to monitor where all of the Jets' first-round picks end up.
